# Task 041 shared whitespace-visible PRESERVE conformance corpus.
#
# ONE canonical corpus drives the Rust, C++, and Ada generated validators.
#
# THIS FILE IS THE PRESERVE HALF ONLY.
# The collapse half lives in whitespace-visible-collapse.txt and has DIFFERENT
# expectations for the same inputs. An input such as "  a   b  " is stored
# UNCHANGED here and as "a b" there. The two files are deliberately separate so
# one policy's expectations cannot be copied onto the other.
#
# FORMAT
#   '#' begins a comment line; blank lines are ignored.
#   VALID <input> => <expected stored form>
#   INVALID <input>
# Exactly one space follows the VALID/INVALID keyword.
# <input> is escaped so whitespace and control cases are unambiguous:
#   \s space   \t tab   \n line feed   \r carriage return   \\ backslash
#   \u{HEX} any code point
#   <empty> the EMPTY field, as a whole field only.
#
# THE <empty> TOKEN
# See the collapse corpus for why an explicit token is needed. Here it appears
# as an INVALID INPUT: this profile's minLength is 1, so the empty string is
# REJECTED. That is the case that proves the token is not merely a synonym for
# "valid and empty" -- it is a way to write the empty INPUT, whose outcome
# depends entirely on the profile.
#
#   Some("") = construction succeeded, stored value is the empty String
#   None     = rejected
#
# AUTHORITY
# Read verbatim from the pinned UCI 2.6 release bytes:
#   UCI 2.6 78eb61b6112c8bffa40820c33124b57787fc5bd9
#           UCI_SecurityMarkings_v2_6_0.xsd:8578 (1024)
#           UCI_SecurityMarkings_v2_6_0.xsd:8588 (4096)
#
#   <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
#     <xs:minLength value="1"/>
#     <xs:maxLength value="1024"/>
#     <xs:pattern value="[&#x20;-&#x7E;\n\r]{1,1024}"/>
#   </xs:restriction>
#
# There is NO whiteSpace facet, so xs:string's intrinsic `preserve` applies.
# This is NOT inherited from UCI 2.5 merely because the declaration names match:
# 2.5 carries an explicit collapse facet and a ZERO minimum, and its
# expectations are in the other corpus.
#
# The minLength facet and the pattern quantifier's lower bound are BOTH 1 here.
# They were read independently from the pinned bytes; the agreement is an
# observation, not an inference from the quantifier.
#
# THE CHARACTER CLASS
# [ -~\n\r] is U+0020 SPACE .. U+007E TILDE, PLUS U+000A and U+000D.
#
# TAB IS REJECTED
# This is the sharpest difference from the collapse half. TAB (U+0009) is
# admitted by neither the printable interval nor the two escapes \n and \r, and
# no normalization runs to turn it into a SPACE, so a value containing TAB is
# INVALID. Under collapse the same input is valid, because the TAB has already
# become a SPACE before the class is consulted.
#
# NOTHING IS TRIMMED OR COLLAPSED
# Leading, trailing, and repeated interior whitespace are all STORED UNCHANGED,
# and remain significant for equality. LF and CR are preserved, not turned into
# SPACE and not removed.
#
# BOUNDS
# This corpus is written for the 1..1024 member.

# --- INVALID: the empty input ---
# minLength = 1. This is the same empty input the collapse corpus accepts.
INVALID <empty>

# --- VALID: whitespace-only values are ORDINARY values here ---
# SPACE is a class member and nothing is trimmed, so these round-trip exactly.
VALID \s => \s
VALID \s\s\s => \s\s\s
VALID \n => \n
VALID \r => \r
VALID \n\n\n => \n\n\n
VALID \r\n => \r\n
VALID \n\r => \n\r
VALID \s\n\s\r\s => \s\n\s\r\s

# --- VALID: the class boundaries themselves ---
VALID ~ => ~
VALID ! => !
VALID } => }
VALID | => |
VALID 0 => 0
VALID 9 => 9
VALID A => A
VALID z => z

# --- VALID: leading and trailing runs are PRESERVED ---
VALID \sabc => \sabc
VALID abc\s => abc\s
VALID \s\s\sabc\s\s\s => \s\s\sabc\s\s\s
VALID \nabc\r => \nabc\r

# --- VALID: interior runs are PRESERVED, never collapsed ---
VALID a\sb => a\sb
VALID a\s\sb => a\s\sb
VALID a\s\s\s\s\sb => a\s\s\s\s\sb
VALID a\nb => a\nb
VALID a\rb => a\rb
VALID a\r\nb => a\r\nb
VALID a\n\s\rb => a\n\s\rb
VALID line1\nline2\nline3 => line1\nline2\nline3

# --- VALID: ordinary words and punctuation ---
VALID hello => hello
VALID Callsign-7 => Callsign-7
VALID a,b.c;d:e!f?g => a,b.c;d:e!f?g
VALID {a|b}~c => {a|b}~c

# --- INVALID: TAB, which the preserved pattern EXCLUDES ---
# The collapse corpus accepts every one of these, normalized.
INVALID \t
INVALID a\tb
INVALID \tabc
INVALID abc\t
INVALID a\t\tb

# --- INVALID: characters OUTSIDE the class ---
INVALID \u{0}
INVALID a\u{0}b
INVALID \u{b}
INVALID a\u{b}b
INVALID \u{c}
INVALID a\u{c}b
INVALID \u{1f}
INVALID a\u{1f}b
INVALID \u{7f}
INVALID a\u{7f}b
# NO-BREAK SPACE and other non-ASCII whitespace.
INVALID \u{a0}
INVALID a\u{a0}b
INVALID a\u{2028}b
INVALID a\u{3000}b
# Non-ASCII letters and multibyte characters.
INVALID caf\u{e9}
INVALID \u{5e74}
INVALID a\u{1f600}b
